Bollywood actors participate in Ganpati Visarjan

Actors Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt participated in the Ganpati Visarjan ceremony. Ranbir Kapoor was seen carrying the idol, while Alia Bhatt shielded their daughter Raha from camera flashes. Neetu Kapoor also joined the event. The actors reportedly offered sweets to the paparazzi present.
